note: Recommended Tower models per VRAM tier. model id on the host = repo:quant; sizes are the GGUF file size.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.notes: Thinking model: give Answer length 2048 or more. The smallest model with dependable tool calls.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.notes: No thinking phase, so first tokens arrive fast; plain answers.

models.name: Gemma 3 12B
models.notes: Uses the text tool format on most builds; steady on host and alert questions.

models.name: Qwen3 14B
models.notes: Thinking model: give Answer length 2048 or more. Strong tool calls at this size.

models.name: Gemma 3 27B
models.notes: Needs a 24 GB card on its own; slower first token than the 12B.

models.name: Qwen3 32B
models.notes: Thinking model: give Answer length 2048 or more. Fills a 24 GB card; leaves no room for a second model.
